peircean_analysis.firstness: Android data partition image, Pixel 3 rooted with Magisk v23000. FDE active — keymaster_key_blob present, content inaccessible. Log4Shell CVE-2021-44228 bookmark/search against VMware vCenter. Wire app 7 bookmarks + Bumble chat with Discord handles PostMaster#9650/DesertBusDriver#9827 exchanged. Cross-case flag: VIGIA-REAL-MAGNET-2022-LINUX-RAFAEL (same actor).
peircean_analysis.secondness: FDE blocks most content. Available metadata shows: active research into a critical RCE CVE targeting enterprise vCenter infrastructure; use of Wire (encrypted messenger) alongside pseudonymous Discord handle exchange across Bumble (dating app used as OPSEC-aware secondary channel). The handle exchange on Bumble to move to Discord is itself an OPSEC technique — moving from semi-identifiable platform to pseudonymous one.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: Android device is the research and coordination layer of a two-device operation. Linux Rafael machine (cross-case) carries the attack tools. Pattern: research CVE on mobile, coordinate via OPSEC comms, execute via Linux attack box. Deliberate channel separation between research device and execution device is an OPSEC architecture.

hypotheses.H1_attack_research_opsec: Rafael researching Log4Shell for offensive use, OPSEC-aware comms for coordination. Android = research+coordination layer; Linux = execution.
hypotheses.H2_security_student: Champlain College student legitimately researching Log4Shell. Wire/Discord normal for tech communities. Magisk rooting for development/research.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: Security student at Champlain College (known cybersecurity program) legitimately researching Log4Shell for academic or bug-bounty purposes. Magisk rooting common among Android developers. Wire and Discord handles are normal in tech communities.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H2 partially survives on Android evidence alone. BUT cross-case correlation with Linux Rafael (compiled attack tools, active bash_history) confirms the research translated into attack preparation. H2 cannot survive the cross-case evidence.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H2 PARTIALLY REFUTED by cross-case correlation. INTENT is the defensible verdict — MALICE not established from Android artifacts alone (FDE limits direct access).

devil_advocate: FDE means we cannot see what was actually on the device. The Log4Shell bookmark could be defensive research. Champlain College has a strong cybersecurity program — students regularly research CVEs. Wire and Discord are mainstream apps. Without decrypting the partition, all Android-side evidence is circumstantial.
